Compare HVLS Fan Manufacturers to Competitors

Big Ass Fans
Big Ass Fans produces high volume low speed (HVLS) fans and ceiling fans within the air movement technology sector. The company offers products including industrial and residential ceiling fans and evaporative coolers. Big Ass Fans primarily serves sectors requiring large space cooling solutions, such as warehouses, fitness centers, and residential properties. Big Ass Fans was formerly known as Big Ass Solutions. It was founded in 1999 and is based in Lexington, Kentucky.

A

Airvance Group
Airvance Group operates in the air treatment and insulation sector within the HVAC industry. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes systems that aim to address comfort, indoor air quality, and energy performance in buildings. Airvance Group's offerings focus on energy efficiency and environmental impact in the built environment. Airvance Group was formerly known as France Air Group. It was founded in 1994 and is based in Beynost, France.

National Trade Supply
National Trade Supply is an e-commerce company specializing in HVAC-related products within the home improvement sector. The company offers a range of products focused on air and water quality and energy efficiency for residential and business environments. National Trade Supply primarily serves the home improvement and maintenance market, providing components like air and water filters. It was founded in 2002 and is based in Indianapolis, Indiana.

Energy Wall
Energy Wall provides indoor air quality solutions within the HVAC industry. The company offers energy recovery ventilators (ERV) designed for moisture and temperature transfer using a ceramic fiber membrane infused with lithium chloride. Energy Wall's products are modular and lightweight, suitable for various applications including classrooms, sports complexes, and public libraries. It was founded in 2008 and is based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

C

Compresseurs Robitaille
Compresseurs Robitaille provides industrial air compressors and related services within the industrial equipment sector. The company offers products such as air treatment systems, vacuum pumps, nitrogen generators, air dryers, and filtration systems, along with parts and maintenance services. Compresseurs Robitaille serves sectors that require industrial air compressor solutions and maintenance. It was founded in 1981 and is based in Sherbrooke, Canada.

A

Air End Repair
Air End Repair provides servicing, reconditioning, and repair of compressors and blowers across various types and brands within the industrial sector. The company offers services, including overhauls, in-house stock management, service exchange, and the provision of compressor oil. Air End Repair caters to a diverse clientele in the industrial machinery sector, ensuring repairs and replacements with a warranty. It was founded in 2011 and is based in Birmingham, United Kingdom.
